enum T_GAPS_READ_TYPE

GAPS client read type.

Values:

enumerator GAPS_READ_DEVICE_NAME

Read type for gaps_read to read Device Name characteristic value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback. The structure of read result data is T_DEVICE_NAME.

enumerator GAPS_READ_APPEARANCE

Read type for gaps_read to read Appearance characteristic value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback.

enumerator GAPS_READ_CENTRAL_ADDR_RESOLUTION

Read type for gaps_read to read Central Address Resolution characteristic value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback.

enum T_GAPS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE

GAPS client callback type.

Values:

enumerator GAPS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_DISC_STATE

Discovery procedure state, done or pending.

enumerator GAPS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_READ_RESULT

Read request's result data, responded from server.

enumerator GAPS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_INVALID

Invalid callback type, no practical usage.
